places.name: Dago
places.description: Bandung's coolest ridge-top boulevard — 1km of Dutch colonial villas converted into cafés, art spaces, and creative workshops under the shadow of the Bandung highlands.
highlights: Dago Art House — rotating contemporary Indonesian exhibitions
Hutan Kota Park at the top of the ridge
Panoramic views toward Gunung Tangkuban Perahu
Highest density of independent coffee roasters in Bandung

places.name: Braga Street
places.description: Bandung's most photogenic colonial street — a 400m pedestrian strip of 1920s art deco storefronts, once called the 'Paris van Java' shopping boulevard by Dutch colonists.
highlights: Braga City Walk — restored art deco facades from the 1920s
Majestic Theatre building (1925) — now a boutique hotel
Braga Night Market every Friday and Saturday evening
Highest concentration of Dutch-era heritage buildings in Bandung

places.name: Kawah Putih
places.description: A volcanic crater lake south of Bandung — the water shifts between turquoise, white, and jade-green with volcanic activity, set inside a caldera at 2,400m altitude.
highlights: Sulphuric crater lake with colour-shifting water
Surrounded by dead volcanic forest and low mist
Cool mountain air year-round at 2,400m
Sunrise arrival gives the crater almost entirely to yourself

places.name: Cihampelas Walk
places.description: Bandung's open-air shopping and food destination — a sky-walk promenade linking rooftop restaurants, Sundanese food stalls, and fashion factory outlets.
highlights: Sky bridge promenade with rooftop views over Bandung
Sundanese cuisine: nasi timbel, karedok, and fresh lalapan
Fashion factory outlets — Bandung's defining retail identity
Evening food court with 40+ stall operators

places.name: Tangkuban Perahu
places.description: The 'overturned boat' stratovolcano defines Bandung's northern skyline — three active craters at 2,084m altitude with sulphuric steam vents, walkable crater rims, and highland strawberry farms on the descent.
highlights: Kawah Ratu — the main accessible crater with active fumaroles
Dawn mist fills the caldera before 08:00, then burns off by 10:00
Edelweiss flowers and wild orchids on crater rim trails
40 min north of Bandung — combine with Lembang dairy farms

places.name: Lembang Highland
places.description: Bandung's cool-air satellite town at 1,300m — a ribbon of highland farms, strawberry picking, dairy co-ops, and colonial-era botanical walks along the Cikapundung River headwaters.
highlights: Floating Market Lembang — warungs on rafts in a mountain reservoir
Strawberry farms open for self-picking from June through September
Lembang dairy — fresh susu pasteurisasi direct from the cooperative
Coolest air in the Bandung basin, often 12°C at sunrise
